items.headline: A stunner in Miami — Messi's side is out of the Leagues Cup
items.body: Inter Miami crashed out in the group phase after a 3-2 loss to Liga MX side Club León — their worst Leagues Cup run ever, finishing 15th. Lionel Messi came off the bench to a huge ovation in his first match since his father Jorge passed away, but Daniel Pinter and Yannick Bright's goals weren't enough as León rallied late.
items.say: Did you see Messi's Miami got knocked out of the Leagues Cup? Rough one — a Mexican side came back on them in the second half. Nice moment though, the crowd gave him a big welcome back. You catch any of it?

items.headline: Burrow and Chase pick up right where they left off — Bengals top the Lions
items.body: Real football is creeping back: Cincinnati beat Detroit 16-14 in their preseason opener, and it took Joe Burrow all of two plays to fire a 16-yard dart to Ja'Marr Chase. Burrow played just 13 snaps (5-of-6 passing), the defense forced two early turnovers, and Evan McPherson booted three field goals. First preseason-opener win for the Bengals since 2021.
items.say: Preseason's underway — Burrow hit Ja'Marr Chase on basically the second play of the game like they never took a break. Bengals beat the Lions. You got a team you're excited about this year?

items.headline: Title fight in Philly — Makhachev defends against Ian Machado Garry on Saturday
items.body: The UFC lands in Philadelphia for the first time ever with a big one: pound-for-pound king Islam Makhachev puts his lightweight belt on the line against unbeaten Irish talker Ian Machado Garry (Sat, 10pm ET on Paramount+). It's grappling-master-vs-slick-striker, and Garry has been talking all week — exactly the kind of clash-of-styles main event that delivers.
items.say: There's a big UFC title fight Saturday night in Philly — Makhachev, the best fighter in the world, against this cocky undefeated Irish guy who won't stop talking. Should be a good one. You watch the fights?

items.headline: The best two weeks of summer baseball are almost here — LLWS starts Tuesday
items.body: The Little League World Series returns to Williamsport, Pennsylvania on Aug 19, with 20 teams (10 from the U.S., 10 from around the world) chasing the title through Aug 30. It's the 79th edition, the regionals just wrapped, and the whole thing is on ESPN/ABC — pure, unfiltered, cry-if-you-lose baseball joy.
items.say: Little League World Series starts Tuesday — honestly some of the most fun baseball all year, those kids go all out. You ever get sucked into watching it?

items.headline: Matthew McConaughey is back — the wild 'Rivals of Amziah King' opens today
items.body: McConaughey's return to the big screen is a strange, wonderful one: he plays a charismatic bluegrass-bandleader who also runs the best honey operation in backwoods Oklahoma, until his estranged foster daughter comes home and rival beekeepers threaten it all. From the director of 'The Vast of Night,' it's been sitting at a jaw-dropping 97% since SXSW.
items.say: New Matthew McConaughey movie's out — he plays a honey-farming bluegrass musician in rural Oklahoma, and critics are obsessed with it. Sounds bonkers in a good way. You still a McConaughey guy?

items.headline: The Script are back — new album 'The User's Guide To Being Human' lands today
items.body: The Irish band behind 'Hall of Fame,' 'Breakeven' and 'The Man Who Can't Be Moved' return with a new record, led by the big, get-back-up anthem 'Man in the Arena.' It's a heartfelt chapter for a band that kept going after losing founding guitarist Mark Sheehan — and there's a huge arena tour to match.
items.say: The Script put out a new album today — you know, 'Hall of Fame,' that stadium-anthem band. The new single 'Man in the Arena' is very them. You into that kind of thing?

items.headline: Tinashe drops a rave-y new one — 'Melatonin' is the video everyone's copying
items.body: The 'Nasty' star is back with 'Melatonin,' a jittery, maximalist dance track and a video packed with dancers that's already spawning TikTok routines. It samples a viral clip and sets up her next album, 'Popstar,' due Sept 25. Perfect end-of-summer-playlist energy.
items.say: Tinashe has a new song out — 'Melatonin,' this big dance-y thing with a video that's all over TikTok. She's the 'Nasty' one from a couple years back. You come across it yet?

items.headline: True-crime bingers, clear your weekend — the Manson 'Tapes' hit Netflix
items.body: The 'Conversations with a Killer' series — the one that did the Ted Bundy tapes — is back for its final chapter with 'The Charles Manson Tapes,' three episodes built around previously unheard prison recordings of Manson himself. Joe Berlinger directs. Dark, gripping, and very much this weekend's water-cooler binge.
items.say: There's a new Manson documentary on Netflix — the same people who did the Ted Bundy Tapes, using recordings of him nobody's heard before. Creepy stuff. You into the true-crime rabbit hole at all?
